topics.title: Carl Wilson’s Death Announcement
topics.summary: The broadcast discusses Carl Wilson’s death at age 51 due to lung and brain cancer. The conversation began with recollections of his musical contributions, including guitar work for the Beach Boys and discussions about their formation after brothers returned from the beach discussing recording a record label.

topics.title: Michael Hutchins Death Report
topics.summary: The coroner’s report confirms Michael Hutchins died by suicide after a night of heavy drinking including vodka, beer and champagne. He expressed concerns about custody issues with Paul Yates before his death, attempted to contact loved ones, and was found unresponsive in his hotel room.

topics.title: Mason Investigation & Fawcett Assault Details
topics.summary: Following reports of Anthony Mason’s alleged involvement in sexual encounters with two men and his cousin’s charges, an investigation into Farrah Fawcett’s assault involved forensic examination including footprint analysis on her crotch. Speculation continued regarding Princess Diana's death and potential treatment outcomes.

topics.title: DNC Aide’s Relationship Disclosure Revelation
topics.summary: A Democratic National Committee aide disclosed a long-term romantic relationship with another woman, confirmed by photographic evidence. Following the disclosure, the aide stated his wife and five children accepted this arrangement, asserting it was an ‘affectionate relationship’.

topics.title: Discussion of Blues Brothers Film & Car Crash Scene
topics.summary: Participants discuss the *Blues Brothers* film, featuring performances by John Goodman, Dan Aykroyd, and Aretha Franklin. They reference a car crash stunt involving Vietnamese children as part of the filmmaking process alongside comparisons to other films like *Animal House*, and mention box office receipts for *Replacement Killers*.

topics.title: Guests Discuss Asian Action Stars and Film
topics.summary: Participants discuss perceptions of Asian action stars, referencing their stunt work and film roles. The conversation includes opinions on Jackie Chan comparisons, Howard Chow Young Fat, Mira Savino, and a segment featuring the movie "Replacement Killer." Gary Oldman expresses discomfort with mainstream cinematic portrayals.
